description: Use this when the user asks which moments to clip or what a campaign's videos are: the analyzed source videos of a campaign and the moments worth clipping in each. Per source the video details we store: title, the channel it came from, publish date, length, view count, language, speaker count, chapters with their times, format (shape and on-screen text lines), readiness (how clip-ready it is), Clip Potential (0 to 100) and a short summary in our own words. A brand file is named by its number, never by its file name, and has no link here. Per moment the start and end, what happens there in our own words, its score, whether it opens on a spoken line, its 9:16 fit and a Watch link that opens the original video at that second. Every moment of the Moment Map, signed in or not, with brand risk moments flagged. Signed in, the videos the clipping platform gives the clippers who join carry their details and Watch links too. Never a transcript or a transcript line. Signed in, a separate ClippingAlpha tool cuts a moment of any video or brand file listed here into a vertical MP4 with captions. Read only, this tool cuts nothing.

campaign.description: The campaign as brand/series (for example lovable/clipping), its clippingalpha.com page URL, or its numeric campaignId from another tool.

source_id.description: Only this source, by the sourceId of an earlier answer.
